Coral colour score under diuron and three climate scenarios

Source: R/data.R
coral_colour.Rd

Colour score of the reef-building coral Acropora millepora after a 14-day exposure to the photosystem II herbicide diuron, crossed with three climate scenarios, from Flores et al. (2021). The scenarios are the temperature and partial pressure of carbon dioxide projected for 2018, 2050 and 2100.

Format

An object of class data.frame with 180 rows and 8 columns.

Details

The design is three climate scenarios by five diuron concentrations by three chambers, with four coral fragments in each chamber: 45 chambers and 180 fragments. A chamber sits at one concentration, so it spans no part of the concentration-response curve and admits only a displacement — the within-concentration structure vignette("example8") demonstrates with ogl(chamber).

Five concentrations is at the conventional minimum for a concentration-response design, and this dataset exists partly to show what that limit does. Equations of four curve parameters do not sample reliably against five concentrations while equations of three do, and the failure appears as divergent transitions rather than as an error.

Colour was scored from image pixel intensity before and after the exposure, reported here as t0_pixel and t14_pixel. intensity is a derived score on the unit interval and proportion is exactly its complement. How intensity was derived is not recorded, and it is not any of the obvious normalisations of the two pixel columns, so it is shipped as supplied rather than reconstructed. Exactly one fragment has an intensity of 1 and therefore a proportion of 0, which is the signature of a score normalised to the largest value in the dataset and is a boundary a Beta likelihood cannot represent. See vignette("example6") for what to do with a value on a boundary.

The control concentration is reported as 0. The source file also holds a column substituting 0.1 for it so that a log predictor can be taken; that substitution is not shipped, because substituting at a boundary is the practice vignette("example6") argues against and a user who wants it can make it and say so.

The columns are as follows:

climate

Climate scenario (fct), "2018", "2050" or "2100".

diuron

Diuron concentration in \(\mu\)g/L (dbl), one of 0, 0.29, 0.96, 2.9 and 29.

chamber

Exposure chamber (fct), 45 levels, each at one climate scenario and one concentration.

fragment

Coral fragment within chamber (int), 1 to 4.

t0_pixel

Mean image pixel intensity at the start of the exposure (dbl).

t14_pixel

Mean image pixel intensity after 14 days (dbl).

intensity

Derived colour intensity on the unit interval (dbl). Exactly one observation is 1.

proportion

1 - intensity (dbl), the response used in vignette("example8"). Exactly one observation is 0.

References

Flores F, Marques JA, Uthicke S, Fisher R, Patel F, Kaserzon S, Negri AP (2021) Combined effects of climate change and the herbicide diuron on the coral Acropora millepora. Marine Pollution Bulletin, 169: 112582. doi: 10.1016/j.marpolbul.2021.112582.

Examples

head(coral_colour)
#>   climate diuron chamber fragment t0_pixel t14_pixel intensity proportion
#> 1    2018      0     c01        1    75.63     95.61 0.2081114  0.7918886
#> 2    2018      0     c01        2    94.82    102.03 0.2468549  0.7531451
#> 3    2018      0     c01        3    81.74    121.59 0.3648959  0.6351041
#> 4    2018      0     c01        4   105.51    117.34 0.3392479  0.6607521
#> 5    2018      0     c02        1    69.93    118.29 0.3449810  0.6550190
#> 6    2018      0     c02        2    77.41    100.55 0.2379233  0.7620767
with(coral_colour, table(climate, diuron))
#>        diuron
#> climate  0 0.29 0.96 2.9 29
#>    2018 12   12   12  12 12
#>    2050 12   12   12  12 12
#>    2100 12   12   12  12 12
